name: Heatmap Matrix
summary: Categorical x × y matrix coloured by value — correlation matrices, monthly return tables, peer scorecards — with cell labels and a colour legend.
summary_zh: 按数值着色的类别矩阵：相关系数矩阵、月度收益表、同业评分卡；单元格内直接标注数值并带色阶图例。
description_zh: 长表数据（x 类别、y 类别、数值，每行一个单元格）绘制成矩阵，颜色深浅表示数值大小。跨越中点（默认 0）的数据自动使用发散色阶（负值红、正值蓝），否则使用顺序色阶；单元格内的数字按字段格式显示，文字颜色根据底色自动切换以保证可读。相关系数矩阵可只显示下三角并去掉对角线；月度收益表可把月份数字映射为 Jan–Dec，并在右侧追加按行汇总列（合计、平均或复利年度收益）。可按名称或均值排序、高亮目标公司，点击某行/列可交叉筛选。
avoid_when: Continuous x / y (use scatter or a density chart)
Exact comparison of a few values (use bar or table)
More than ~30 categories per axis (labels become unreadable)

min.desc: Colour domain minimum (default: data minimum; diverging is symmetric around mid)

triangle.desc: false | 'lower' | 'upper' — hide the mirrored half of a symmetric matrix

sortY.desc: Row order, same choices as sortX

yLabels.desc: Row label mapping, same choices as xLabels

labels.desc: Cell value labels: true | false | 'auto' (when cells are wide enough)

format.desc: Value format (defaults to the value field format)

summary.desc: null | 'sum' | 'mean' | 'compound' — extra column summarising each row

summaryLabel.desc: Summary column header (default Total / Average / Year)

highlight.desc: Category value(s) emphasised on both axes (e.g. the target ticker)

select.desc: null | 'x' | 'y' — click a cell to cross-filter on that column / row field

legend.desc: Colour legend (top-left); hover a value to highlight matching cells

interactions: Hover the colour legend to highlight cells in that range
Optional click a cell to cross-filter its row or column
